correctness.rationale: The 2,574-faces exhaustive Hasse diagram admits a verified acyclic 1,269-pair matching with one 0-cell, five 3-cells, thirty 4-cells. The only integral Morse boundary has exact rank two and Smith factors (1,2), checked from signed gradient paths and independently by full simplicial ranks over primes 2, 3, 5, plus alternate matchings. The three-skeleton is a wedge of five 3-spheres and the degree-four attachments are classified by this integer matrix. Hence three S3, twenty-eight S4 and one mod-two Moore M(Z/2,3).

value.rationale: A natural complete cyclic orientation of a three-shore graph yields nontrivial integral two-torsion and a precise mod-two Moore summand. The full homotopy decomposition, including free-sphere ranks, is not implied by rational or mod-two Betti data alone and supplies an exact benchmark for multipath-complex torsion beyond one-way and bidirected bipartite examples.
